messageSchema.description: Public SBE WebSocket contract for real-time market data: trades, best bid and offer, top-20 order book depth, and a live order book window kept by snapshot and incremental updates

composite.name: messageHeader
composite.description: Eight-byte SBE header that prefixes every WebSocket binary message

type.name: blockLength
type.description: Encoded length in bytes of the message fixed block, excluding this header and repeating groups

type.name: templateId
type.description: Message template identifier used to select the payload type

type.name: schemaId
type.description: Schema identifier; must equal 20 for this contract

type.name: version
type.description: Schema version used by the sender to encode the message; a reader skips fixed-block bytes past those it knows by blockLength

type.name: blockLength
type.description: Encoded size in bytes of each group entry

type.name: numInGroup
type.description: Number of entries following this header

type.name: ZeroNullUint8
type.description: Optional one-byte value whose null is zero; encodes enumerations that define no value zero

type.name: ZeroNullUint64
type.description: Optional unsigned 64-bit value whose null is zero

type.name: OptionalPriceTicks
type.description: Optional price in quote-asset units scaled by 1e9; null is the minimum 64-bit signed value (-9223372036854775808)

enum.name: Side
enum.description: Direction of the order that took liquidity in a trade

validValue.name: BUY
validValue.description: The taker bought the base asset

validValue.name: SELL
validValue.description: The taker sold the base asset

enum.name: StreamType
enum.description: Market-data stream of one trading pair

validValue.name: TRADES
validValue.description: Every trade of the pair in real time, with a trade frontier and explicit skipped ranges

validValue.name: BBO
validValue.description: The best bid and offer of the pair in real time; a subscriber that falls behind receives only the newest

validValue.name: DEPTH20
validValue.description: The best 20 price levels per side as full replacement snapshots, sent at most every 20 milliseconds when they change and at least every second

validValue.name: DEPTH
validValue.description: A live window of the best price levels per side: a DepthSnapshot on subscribe, then a DepthUpdate for every book update. A subscriber that falls behind, or a book the server must rebuild, receives a replacement DepthSnapshot

validValue.name: OK
validValue.description: For a Subscribe item, the stream is subscribed and its messages follow on this connection. For an Unsubscribe item, the stream is unsubscribed and none of its messages follow the response; subscribing again starts the stream afresh, with a new DepthSnapshot for depth and a new TradesThrough baseline for trades

validValue.name: UNKNOWN_SYMBOL
validValue.description: The trading pair is not served on this endpoint

validValue.name: LIMIT_EXCEEDED
validValue.description: The connection already holds the most subscriptions it may; this item is not subscribed and the connection is unchanged

validValue.name: ALREADY_SUBSCRIBED
validValue.description: The connection already holds this subscription; it is unchanged

validValue.name: NOT_SUBSCRIBED
validValue.description: Answers an Unsubscribe item the connection does not hold; the connection is unchanged

validValue.name: SYMBOL_DISABLED
validValue.description: The trading pair is listed but disabled; subscribe again once it is enabled

enum.name: FeedState
enum.description: Whether the server holds the current state of a trading pair's market data

validValue.name: STALE
validValue.description: The server lost the pair's current state; best bid and offer and depth messages pause until it recovers, when each depth subscription receives a replacement DepthSnapshot and trade gaps are reported

message.name: Subscribe
message.description: Client request to subscribe to streams; answered by one SubscribeResponse with one result per item, in order

field.name: requestId
field.description: Client-chosen identifier echoed in the SubscribeResponse

field.name: symbolId
field.description: Numeric trading pair identifier as returned by the spot configuration API

field.name: stream
field.description: Stream to subscribe to

message.name: Unsubscribe
message.description: Client request to end subscriptions; answered by one SubscribeResponse with one result per item, in order. No message of an unsubscribed stream follows the response

field.name: requestId
field.description: Client-chosen identifier echoed in the SubscribeResponse

field.name: symbolId
field.description: Numeric trading pair identifier as returned by the spot configuration API

field.name: stream
field.description: Stream to unsubscribe from

message.name: Ping
message.description: Client liveness probe; answered by one Pong

field.name: requestId
field.description: Client-chosen identifier echoed in the Pong

message.name: SubscribeResponse
message.description: Server answer to one Subscribe or Unsubscribe; a subscribed stream's first message follows its OK result, and an unsubscribed stream's messages end before it

field.name: requestId
field.description: The Subscribe or Unsubscribe request's requestId

group.name: results
group.description: One result per requested item, in request order

field.name: symbolId
field.description: The item's trading pair identifier

field.name: stream
field.description: The item's stream

field.name: result
field.description: The item's outcome

field.name: requestId
field.description: The Ping request's requestId

field.name: sendTsNs
field.description: Server time at which this message was encoded, in Unix nanoseconds UTC

message.name: Trades
message.description: Trades of the trades stream: up to 256 fills of one book update in match order. A larger update is several messages with the same updateId. Each trade is delivered at most once per subscription; a trade that cannot be delivered is named in a TradesSkipped

field.name: symbolId
field.description: Numeric trading pair identifier

field.name: bookEpoch
field.description: Book epoch of the trades; it increases when the pair's book is rebuilt

field.name: updateId
field.description: Book update that executed the trades; the depth stream numbers its state with the same sequence within bookEpoch

field.name: transactTsNs
field.description: Time of the book update that executed the trades, in Unix nanoseconds UTC

field.name: sendTsNs
field.description: Server time at which this message was encoded, in Unix nanoseconds UTC; minus transactTsNs, an estimate of server-side latency

field.name: tradeId
field.description: Trade identifier, the matchId the trade history API returns. Contiguous per pair within a bookEpoch, starting at (bookEpoch-1)*2^40+1; trades of a later bookEpoch have higher identifiers

field.name: priceTicks
field.description: Execution price in quote-asset units scaled by 1e9

field.name: qtyScaled
field.description: Executed quantity in base-asset units scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale

field.name: takerSide
field.description: Side of the order that took liquidity

message.name: BestBidOffer
message.description: Best bid and offer of a bbo subscription, sent when the best price or quantity of either side changes and re-sent unchanged every second. Only the newest is sent to a subscriber that falls behind. Keep the message with the highest (bookEpoch, updateId); an equal pair is a re-send that confirms liveness

field.name: symbolId
field.description: Numeric trading pair identifier

field.name: bookEpoch
field.description: Book epoch; it increases when the pair's book is rebuilt

field.name: updateId
field.description: Book update whose state this message shows; the same sequence numbers depth20 and trades within bookEpoch, strictly increasing between changes but not contiguous

field.name: transactTsNs
field.description: Time of the book update this message shows, in Unix nanoseconds UTC

field.name: sendTsNs
field.description: Server time at which this message was encoded, in Unix nanoseconds UTC; minus transactTsNs, an estimate of server-side latency

field.name: bidPriceTicks
field.description: Best bid price in quote-asset units scaled by 1e9; null when the book has no bids

field.name: bidQtyScaled
field.description: Total resting quantity at the best bid in base-asset units scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale; 0 when the book has no bids

field.name: askPriceTicks
field.description: Best ask price in quote-asset units scaled by 1e9; null when the book has no asks

field.name: askQtyScaled
field.description: Total resting quantity at the best ask in base-asset units scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale; 0 when the book has no asks

message.name: DepthSnapshot
message.description: Full replacement of the best price levels of a depth20 or depth subscription. On depth20, keep the message with the highest (bookEpoch, updateId); an equal pair is an unchanged re-send that confirms liveness. On depth, it replaces the book whatever it held, and the DepthUpdates that follow continue from its updateId

field.name: symbolId
field.description: Numeric trading pair identifier

field.name: stream
field.description: Stream this snapshot belongs to

field.name: bookEpoch
field.description: Book epoch; it increases when the pair's book is rebuilt

field.name: updateId
field.description: Book update whose state this snapshot shows; strictly increasing within bookEpoch but not contiguous

field.name: transactTsNs
field.description: Time of the book update this snapshot shows, in Unix nanoseconds UTC

field.name: sendTsNs
field.description: Server time at which this message was encoded, in Unix nanoseconds UTC

field.name: levelsPerSide
field.description: Most price levels per side the stream holds: 20 for depth20; for depth, the live window N, to which a subscriber truncates each side, keeping the N best, after applying every DepthUpdate. A side with fewer levels holds every level of that side

group.name: bids
group.description: Bid levels, best (highest price) first; at most levelsPerSide

field.name: priceTicks
field.description: Level price in quote-asset units scaled by 1e9

field.name: qtyScaled
field.description: Total resting quantity at the level in base-asset units scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale

group.name: asks
group.description: Ask levels, best (lowest price) first; at most levelsPerSide

field.name: priceTicks
field.description: Level price in quote-asset units scaled by 1e9

field.name: qtyScaled
field.description: Total resting quantity at the level in base-asset units scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale

message.name: DepthUpdate
message.description: Incremental update of a depth subscription's window. Apply it only to a book at exactly firstUpdateId-1 of the same bookEpoch: the previous DepthUpdate's lastUpdateId, or the DepthSnapshot's updateId. On any other position, discard the book and resubscribe (Unsubscribe, then Subscribe); never apply it to a book taken from another source or to a position inside the range. Each level is a SET of its total quantity, and quantity 0 removes the level. After applying it, truncate each side to the DepthSnapshot's levelsPerSide best levels: a level pushed out of the window by better levels is not removed on the wire

field.name: symbolId
field.description: Numeric trading pair identifier

field.name: bookEpoch
field.description: Book epoch; it increases when the pair's book is rebuilt, and a new epoch always starts with a DepthSnapshot

field.name: firstUpdateId
field.description: First book update this message covers: the update after the position it applies to

field.name: lastUpdateId
field.description: Last book update this message covers, the book's position once applied. A range whose updates changed no level of the window carries no level

field.name: transactTsNs
field.description: Time of the book update lastUpdateId, in Unix nanoseconds UTC

field.name: sendTsNs
field.description: Server time at which this message was encoded, in Unix nanoseconds UTC; minus transactTsNs, an estimate of server-side latency

group.name: bids
group.description: Changed bid levels of the window: levels that changed inside it, entered it from below, or left it because they emptied

field.name: priceTicks
field.description: Level price in quote-asset units scaled by 1e9

field.name: qtyScaled
field.description: Total resting quantity at the level in base-asset units scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale; 0 removes the level

group.name: asks
group.description: Changed ask levels of the window: levels that changed inside it, entered it from below, or left it because they emptied

field.name: priceTicks
field.description: Level price in quote-asset units scaled by 1e9

field.name: qtyScaled
field.description: Total resting quantity at the level in base-asset units scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale; 0 removes the level

message.name: MarketStatus
message.description: Feed state of a trading pair, sent to every subscription of the pair when it changes and when a subscription starts while the pair is stale

field.name: symbolId
field.description: Numeric trading pair identifier

field.name: feed
field.description: Whether the pair's streams are current

field.name: sendTsNs
field.description: Server time at which this message was encoded, in Unix nanoseconds UTC

message.name: TradesSkipped
message.description: Trades of the trades stream that this subscription will not receive live. Recover them from the trade history API by trade identifier

field.name: symbolId
field.description: Numeric trading pair identifier

field.name: bookEpoch
field.description: Book epoch of the skipped trades

field.name: firstTradeId
field.description: First skipped trade identifier, inclusive

field.name: lastTradeId
field.description: Last skipped trade identifier, inclusive; null (0) means every trade of bookEpoch from firstTradeId on, whose end the trade history API reports once the epoch ends

field.name: sendTsNs
field.description: Server time at which this message was encoded, in Unix nanoseconds UTC

message.name: TradesThrough
message.description: Trade frontier of the trades stream: every trade of bookEpoch with tradeId at or below lastTradeId has been delivered on this subscription or named in a TradesSkipped. Sent first on subscribe as the subscription's baseline, then every second

field.name: symbolId
field.description: Numeric trading pair identifier

field.name: bookEpoch
field.description: Current book epoch

field.name: lastTradeId
field.description: Highest trade identifier of bookEpoch accounted for; (bookEpoch-1)*2^40 before the epoch's first trade

field.name: sendTsNs
field.description: Server time at which this message was encoded, in Unix nanoseconds UTC
